units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 18:14">Targ. Y. Gen. XVIII, 14</cite> <he>זמן ח׳</he> (h. text <he>מועד</he>); a. fr.—
Ḥag. 10ᵇ (ref. to Ex. XII, 14) how can you prove that this ḥag means (festive) offering, דילמא חוגו חגא וכ׳ perhaps it means ‘celebrate a feast’?—

<cite ref="Exodus 12:14">Ib.</cite> <he>דילמא … אכלו … וחוגו ח׳ וכ׳</he> perhaps the text means to say, ‘eat and drink and have a feast (rejoice) before me’ (without alluding to special pilgrims’ offerings)?—

<cite ref="Exodus 12:14">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:18">Ex. XXIII, 18</cite>) <he>ואי ס״ד דחגא הוא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דחוגא</he>) if you would say, <cite ref="H00147"><he>חַגִּי</he></cite> means feast (merry-making) &c.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2:2">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> <he>בין ח׳ וכ׳</he> between the Feast of Booths and Ḥănuckah.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:6">Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חַגַּיָּא</he>, <cite ref="H00136"><he>חַגִּין</he></cite>.
